rejected_rule.statement: A plaintiff can seek an order of ejectment of the defendant who is in unlawful possession of his property without seeking a declaration of title to the same.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: A decree granting such substantive relief is permissible in terms of section 217(F) of the Civil Procedure Code without a prayer for declaratory relief.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 217(F) of the Civil Procedure Code
